metadata.description: Curated collection of global skills, plugins, and AST GraphDB sidecars for agentic AI coding assistants.

plugins.name: ast-graph
plugins.description: Local AST & cross-layer code graph plugin that cuts agent context token usage by jumping straight to exact line spans, blast radius, and covering tests.

plugins.name: feature-flags
plugins.description: Reference plugin demonstrating runtime feature flags via lifecycle hooks (SessionStart, PreInvocation, PreToolUse) and hierarchical workspace/global config files.

plugins.name: thinking-arcade
plugins.description: Session-gated Space Invaders sidecar game (Model Invaders) that plays while your coding agents are thinking, pauses when any conversation needs you, and lists those conversations with one-click links back, across Antigravity, Claude Code, and Codex CLI.

plugins.name: adaptive-learning
plugins.description: Interactive mastery-based learning journeys with embedded <agent-embed> simulators, code diffs, Mermaid diagrams, and closed-loop callback remediation inside native ask_question cards.
